theme_help: Used by the Plain look. Every other look is light or dark on its own.

import.title: Add from code
import.text: Paste a look code someone shared. It is checked before anything is applied.

remove.title: Delete “{name}”?
remove.text: The look is removed from this computer. Copies you shared with others keep working.

editor.name: Name
editor.scene_help: Stickers and images drawn around the window.
editor.needs_newer: Part of this look needs a newer Posthaste.
editor.simple_note: Simple looks is hiding stickers and images in the windows. This preview still shows them.
editor.font_custom_hint: The name of a font installed on this computer, like JetBrains Mono. The font above is used where it isn't installed.
editor.font_not_installed: “{name}” isn't installed on this computer, so you see the font above instead.

simple_help: Keep a look's colours, hide its stickers and images.
share_has_images: Looks with images are shared as a file, not a code.
file_text: Everything in the file was checked. The preview is behind this dialog; adding it stores the look and its images on this computer.
shared_with_font: Copied the code. This look uses the font “{font}”: install it first to see the look as made.
